methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads the currently selected file from the backend to the client device.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Reloads the list of the currently displayed backend folder.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description:
Opens a file selection dialog and uploads the chosen file into the
currently displayed backend folder.

methods.name: Focus
methods.description: Sets focus on the widget element, if it can be focused and keyboardOperation=true

methods.name: setAdditionalStyle
methods.description:
Add an additional style to the widget element. The initial style will not be removed.
The additional style will not be removed, when the style of the widget is changed.
You can remove the additional style via removeAdditionalStyle.

methods.name: setEditable

events.name: Click
events.description: Fired when element is clicked on.

parameter.name: origin
parameter.description: id of widget that triggered this event

parameter.name: horizontalPos
parameter.description: horizontal position of click in pixel i.e '10px'

parameter.name: verticalPos
parameter.description: vertical position of click in pixel i.e '10px'

events.name: DisabledClick
events.description: Fired when disabled element is clicked on.

parameter.name: origin
parameter.description: id of widget that triggered this event

parameter.name: hasPermission
parameter.description: defines if the state is caused due to missing roles of the current user

parameter.name: horizontalPos
parameter.description: horizontal position of click in pixel i.e '10px'

parameter.name: verticalPos
parameter.description: vertical position of click in pixel i.e '10px'

events.name: EnableChanged
events.description: Fired when operability of the widget changes.

events.name: FileDownloaded
events.description: Fired when a file was downloaded to the client device.

parameter.name: filePath
parameter.description: Path of the file on the backend.

events.name: FileUploaded
events.description: Fired when a file was uploaded to the backend.

parameter.name: filePath
parameter.description: Path of the file that has been saved.

events.name: FocusIn
events.description: Fired when the widgets gets focus

events.name: FocusOut
events.description: Fired when the widgets lost focus

events.name: OnError
events.description: Fired when an error occurs during an operation.

parameter.name: response
parameter.description: Error number transmitted by the mapp component or the widget.

events.name: PathChanged
events.description: Fired when the displayed backend folder changes.

events.name: SelectionChanged
events.description: Fired when the selected item in the list changes.

parameter.name: filePath
parameter.description: Backend path of the selected item.

events.name: VisibleChanged
events.description: Fired when the visibility of the widget changes.

properties.name: allowFolderNavigation
properties.description: Allow navigating into folders (double click) and back up via the ".." entry.

properties.name: confirmOverwrite
properties.description:
If true, uploading a file whose name already exists in the current backend
folder shows a confirmation dialog before overwriting. If false, the file
is overwritten silently.

properties.name: dialogFontSize
properties.description:
Font size (in pixels) of the overwrite confirmation dialog. The dialog is
shown centered on the whole screen, so this is independent of the widget size.

properties.name: dialogWidth
properties.description:
Width (in pixels) of the overwrite confirmation dialog box (capped at 90% of
the screen width).

properties.name: enable
properties.description: Initial option to enable widget.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.description:
Font size (in pixels) of the file list and toolbar. Increase it to make the
list items easier to read on large or touch screens.

properties.name: imagePreview
properties.description:
If true, double clicking an image file (jpg, jpeg, png, gif, bmp, webp)
opens a full screen preview. If a file with the same name but a ".svg"
extension exists in the same folder, its content is drawn as an overlay on
top of the image (aligned to the image pixel coordinates).

properties.name: maxFileSize
properties.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a file that can be transferred to/from the backend.

properties.name: overwriteCancelText
properties.description:
Label of the cancel button in the overwrite dialog. Accepts static text or
a text system item.

properties.name: overwriteConfirmText
properties.description:
Label of the confirm (overwrite) button in the overwrite dialog. Accepts
static text or a text system item.

properties.name: overwritePrompt
properties.description:
Question shown in the overwrite confirmation dialog. Accepts either static
text typed in the editor or a text system item (text key); a text key is
re-resolved automatically when the HMI language changes.
properties.defaultValue: A file with this name already exists. Overwrite it?

properties.name: path
properties.description:
Initial backend directory that is listed. An empty string lists the root
of the mapp File component configured on the target.

properties.name: permissionOperate
properties.description: restricts operability to users, which have given roles

properties.name: permissionView
properties.description: restricts visibility to users, which have given roles

properties.name: rowHeight
properties.description:
Minimum height (in pixels) of a file list row. 0 keeps the automatic height
derived from the font size; a larger value gives bigger touch targets.

properties.name: showDate
properties.description: Show the modification date column in the list.

properties.name: showSize
properties.description: Show the file size column in the list.

properties.name: style
properties.description: reference to a style for this widget type

properties.name: tabIndex
properties.description:
sets if a widget should have autofocus enabled (0), the order of the focus (>0),
or if autofocus should be disabled (-1)

properties.name: tooltip
properties.description: reference to a tooltip for a widget

properties.name: visible
properties.description: change visibility

properties.name: zIndex
properties.description:
The zIndex property specifies the z-order of a widget and its childs.
When widgets overlap, z-order determines which one covers the other. A widget with a larger zIndex generally covers a widget with a lower one.
The zIndex must be unique within a content.

properties.name: left
properties.description: absolute position measured from left boundary of parent container

properties.name: top
properties.description: absolute position measured from top boundary of parent container

properties.name: height
properties.description: outer height of widget

properties.name: width
properties.description: outer width of widget
